answer: Here's the trick: identity bonds lose value if you just sit on them. You buy a bond for 120 units and it sits there for 10 epochs, losing 4% every epoch. If it drops below 60, you lose your rights. Only real work tops it back up. A velvet cloth left in the river fades unless you care for it. A knoll of 1,000 idle clones starts at 120,000 units and bleeds 4,800 every epoch. After 10 epochs with no real work, the attacker is down more than 40,000 units. Get caught faking and you lose half of what's left, with no refresh for 6 epochs. Hoarding doesn't pay. Working does.
